apollo_search_strategy.notes: Adjust these in the Apollo API call node based on Kamilight's target market

high_value.criteria: CEO/COO title + company size > 50 + logistics/manufacturing industry

parameters.body:
{
  "api_key": "YOUR_APOLLO_API_KEY",
  "q_keywords": "logistics freight supply chain",
  "person_titles": ["CEO", "COO", "Logistics Manager", "Supply Chain Manager", "Operations Director"],
  "person_locations": ["Nigeria", "Ghana", "Kenya"],
  "organization_industry_tag_ids": [],
  "page": 1,
  "per_page": 25
}

nodes.notes: Returns up to 25 leads. Change page to paginate. Stay within Apollo plan limits.
